flags.summary: The Vistani women at the Blood of the Vine told the party about the man the mists dropped out of the sky (village_of_barovia/vistani:strangers). Part one of three of the hidden The Man Who Fell from the Sky achievement.
The party petted Lupu, the burgomaster's wolfhound (village_of_barovia/the_burgomasters_hound:pet). One of the five good-dog marks the hidden Good Dogs, All achievement reads.
